To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed ultra low loss on chip inductors for power electronics applications.
we have developed ultra low loss magnetic on chip inductors that can replace the existing bulky and lossy off chip inductors for power convertors, including voltage regulators for CPU/GPUs.

we have developed a new magnetic inductor technology that can be integrated in the far BEOl for power management applications and that it is the first inductor technology that enables inductances of 1 nH/mm2 in 1 mm2 area at 100 MHz with Q factor > 20, and that it has a high saturation current and low losses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of ultra low loss magnetic devices for power management in high performance electronics.
the development and integration of ultra low loss on chip inductors in far BEOL that can handle high currents and high AC ripples, thus enabling high frequency power electronics.
the integration of magnetic components into the far back-end-of-line of CMOS technologies for the first time.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we present ultra low losses inductors in 65nm technology node for power management applications.
we have developed an innovative magnetic inductance structure with ultra low loss and high current handling capabilities.
our work is a step towards the integration of high performance magnetic inductors into power electronics and voltage regulators in high performance computing systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to achieve the highest inductance density, the lowest losses and highest current handling in the smallest area, which is the ultimate goal of any inductor design.
our inductors enable a 2x improvement in power density and a 2x reduction in the power loss in the inductor.
we are the first to demonstrate a high saturation current, high inductance density, and high Q factor magnetic inductors with low loss and high frequency operation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a highly optimized laminar magnetic material in inductors is key to achieving ultra high saturation currents and ultra low losses in inductors.
the inductance density can be increased by more than 10 times by using a laminated core instead of a single core, which enables the inductors to be integrated in the far BEO.
it is possible to integrate magnetic inductors with ultra low loss and high saturation current in the far BELO for high frequency power applications.
